The Journey Towards The Championship | evolution=1 | numeps1=9 | firststagename=Pidgey | firstevoep=GB10 | firstevoname=A Huge Mysterious Tree!! | prevonum=016 | evo1num=017 | current=[[Party|With Gold]] | va=no | }} '''Gold's Pidgeotto''' (Japanese: '''ゴールドのピジョン''' ''Gold's Pigeon'') was the first Pokémon that {{GnB|Gold}} {{pkmn2|caught}} in [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]]. ==History== [[File:Gold Pidgey Golden Boys.png|thumb|left|200px|As a Pidgey]] Sometime before Gold began his journey, {{GnB|Black}} caught this Pidgeotto as a Pidgey. As Black thought that it was too weak, he released it. After Gold's battle with {{tc|Youngster}} [[Joey]], he found it injured on the grass. Gold wanted to take Pidgey to a Pokémon Center but there weren't any around and goes to a [[Berry]] tree instead to heal its wounds. Black arrived who revealed his original ownership of Pidgey. During the first rival battle, as {{TP|Gold|Totodile}} was about to lose to {{TP|Black|Chikorita}}, Pidgey steps in and defeats Chikorita with {{m|Gust}}. During the battle with [[Falkner]]'s {{p|Articuno}}, Pidgey assists Totodile and {{TP|Gold|Pikachu}} who recently came from the future. When Pikachu's leg was frozen by Articuno's {{m|Ice Beam}}, Pidgey removed the ice using its beak. Pidgey distracts Articuno in order for Pikachu to finish it off, earning Gold the {{badge|Zephyr}}. Pidgey participated in the Basketball Tournament and was up against {{tc|Firebreather}} Takeo. It goes with Gold to [[Union Cave]] when a {{p|Lapras}} causes ruckus there. Pidgey has a battle with Whitney's {{p|Ditto}} where it ends up facing {{m|Transform|its replica}} and lost. A giant {{p|Sudowoodo}} appears and Pidgey uses Gust combined with Totodile's {{m|Water Gun}} to shrink it down. After Gold caught Sudowoodo, Pidgey ended up evolving into Pidgeotto. Pidgeotto was sent out to clear away the mist that was blocking Gold's and Chris's trail, which revealed a cavern containing an {{p|Ursaring}}. ==Personality and characteristics== Pidgeotto, as a Pidgey, was very cooperative towards other Pokémon. This was shown when it worked with Totodile and Pikachu to defeat Falkner's Articuno, and it also worked with Totodile to defeat a giant Sudowoodo. ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|normal|flying|Gold {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Pidgeotto Gust|1=Pidgey Peck}} Golden Boys.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Gust|1=Peck
